lines: Och, the old slide. We don't talk about it, love. Nobody does.
All I know is, the flowers round it won't grow, and at night there's a wee green glow near the Haunted House.
My gran used to say something got STUCK in that house a long time ago. Something that liked to slide.
Rights for dogs? Aye, of course. Rook dug up my whole carrot patch last week, and I still love him.
(Bramble signs with a big loopy B and a little flower.)
{player}! Over here! I've been standing by this portal so long a butterfly landed on my nose.
The south meadow is blooming tonight. Moonflowers, starbells, the lot. You have to see it!
And something's out there that isn't a flower. Two glowy blue papers, blown in from who knows where. Schematics, Dash calls them.
One's in the middle of the meadow, by the twisty race track. The other's over on the lake side.
Oh! And Zippy's been asking who wants to race. Moo-ve fast and you might win something!
Well, hey there, sugar! Ain't you just the sweetest thing.
I'm Bramble. I grow things, and I fix up anybody who's feelin' poorly.
{player}: Like a doctor?
Sort of! More like a garden that gives hugs.
Sugar! Guess who asked me for flowers? Mr. Palmer himself! Said Rex's campaign gave him the idea.
Flowers in every window box in town. I've got the bundles all tied up, but these old knees creak somethin' awful.
Would you be a dear and fill the boxes for me?
Bless your heart! Here you go, a whole armful.
(Bramble hands {player} a big bundle of flowers. They smell like sunshine.)
Mr. Palmer's window at the Town Hall, Nina's house, the Potion Shop, the Book Store, and Dash's place.
No rush, hon. Flowers don't mind waitin' in a bucket.
How're those window boxes comin', sugar? Each one needs a little love.
Mr. Palmer's, yours, the Potion Shop, the Book Store and Dash's.
{player}: All the window boxes are full, Bramble!
Well, look at you! I could see 'em bloomin' from here.
You know what? I had a few bundles left over. So I snuck round and did the rest of the town too.
(Bramble winks.)
A town with flowers is a town that smiles. Thank you, sugar.
Every window in town's got flowers now. I water 'em on my mornin' walk.
The bees are havin' the best week of their lives.
{player}: Bramble, Rex is running for mayor. What would you want a mayor to do?
Well, ain't that sweet of him to ask!
Flowers, sugar. Flowers in every window box in town. A town with flowers is a town that smiles.
You tell that pup I said so. Kindly.
Portal's open, hon. The flowers by it glow brighter every time. Ain't that somethin'?
Mornin', sugar! These little sprouts need talkin' to. Plants love a good chat.
(Bramble whispers something to a carrot.)
He says hi!
Fresh flowers! I grew every single one of 'em myself, sugar.
(Bramble tucks a little pink flower behind {player}'s ear.)
There. Pretty as a picture.
Waterin' time! Everybody gets a drink before bed, even the plants.
Mornin'! The flowers wake up the same time I do. We do our stretches together.
(Bramble stretches. A daisy nearby seems to stretch too.)
Shh, the plants are sleepin'. We gotta whisper so they grow nice and tall.
{player}: (whispering) Goodnight, plants.

rotate: My best friend's from Scotland. She says 'wee' and I say 'y'all'.
Put us together and we're a whole dictionary!
You look a little tuckered out, darlin'. Want a pick-me-up?

lines: (Bramble pats {player} on the head. Tiny flowers pop up around {their} feet.)
There you go! Fresh as a daisy.
Alright! You holler if you need me.

rotate: Here's to more brain breaks! Sit in the grass a minute, sugar. It helps, I promise.
